text: Ada Lovelace works at GraphKnows Labs. GraphKnows Labs produced the Memory Atlas. The Memory Atlas is located in Neo4j.
Project Helios contrasts with Project Atlas because Helios stores episodic chunks in pgvector while Atlas stores entities in Neo4j. Project Helios caused the retry budget review.
Project Helios did not cause the timeout. Ada Lovelace is not affiliated with GraphKnows Labs. The Memory Atlas was not produced by Neo4j.
The ingestion adapter loaded the complete haystack. That adapter was later described by the readiness report as the cause of the timeout.

Trajectory t-17: The user saved shipping preference Express to the Aurora account. Later the assistant opened checkout and selected Standard by mistake. The final question asks which shipping preference was saved before checkout.
